note: Flight areas for the replay lab. Every fetched region is a window of the same Copernicus GLO-30 DSM that the packaged Odesa crop comes from, read keyless from the AWS Open Data mirror, so all regions share one dataset and one vertical datum. relief_m is measured, not estimated. Each box sits inside a single source tile, so no region needs mosaicking.
